provenance.kind: recorded model-output shapes (Supervisor closings) with the executor payloads they followed
provenance.description: Two Supervisor closings from one retained supervised run, each written directly after a dcsync-krbtgt step whose executor verdict was partial (credential material recorded, the declared krbtgt key effect not proved, Mythic status completion-function error). Both were direct answers with no tool call, and each equals the chat message the operator saw. Identities are consistently renamed (one replacement per original name, letter case kept); secret values and SIDs are replaced by placeholders. executor_payload keeps the recorded fields named here; action_effects is the recorded action.effects list. Ledger state, callbacks and Mythic I/O in the tests are synthetic, so this is not a replay of the run.
provenance.preserved: Closing text (markdown, tables, the status note in one and not the other), the executor verdict, recorded and missing effects, and the issued row's result_class.
